description: This is a Java interface defining the EmployeeRepository for CRUD operations related to Employee objects within the domain layer of the application.

classes.name: EmployeeRepository
classes.description: A repository interface for Employee domain objects, declaring methods for retrieving and manipulating Employee data.

methods.name: findEmployee
methods.description: Retrieves an Employee object by its employeeId.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Saves or updates an Employee object.

methods.name: removeEmployee
methods.description: Removes an Employee identified by employeeId from the repository.
